description.value:
An invented tech upgrade for a weapon capable of Autofire. A weapon with it installed can Full Blast: an Autofire attack that spends twice the usual ammunition and adds 1 to each damage die before the Autofire multiplier. A raised die stops at 6 unless the GM turns on Allow dice results to be modified above 6.

Inventing it is an Upgrade DV24 check. The first cost is the cost of the weapon being upgraded; the second cost, 1,000eb, is this item's price. It takes no upgrade slot. Installed in a weapon without Autofire, it does nothing.

It matters only when the GM turns on Require the Adjustable Gas Piston for Full Blast. Otherwise every Autofire weapon can Full Blast.

Adapted from the Adjustable Gas Piston by u/Infernox-Ratchet, in Heavy Armor Lizard's Autofire Compendium.
